gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed diagnosis of a recurrent/progressive WHO grade IV malignant gliomas (glioblastoma) and meet the following inclusion criteria:
First, second, third or fourth relapse of glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: A therapeutic antibody that binds to and blocks PD-1 located on lymphocytes.

Patients will be treated with recurring 28-day cycles of ERC1671, GM-CSF, Cyclophosphomide, Bevacizumab, and Pembrolizumab until progression of disease and at the discretion of the treating physician.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First, second, third or fourth relapse of glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: ERC1671 is an autologous and allogeneic cells and lysates suspension generated from human glioblastoma (GBM) tumors harvested from patients undergoing surgery for glioblastoma.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous + allogeneic whole tumour cell and lysate cancer vaccine (ERC1671 / Gliovac)

role_evidence.quote: Sargramostim (Leukomax®, Leukine®); yeast-derived, recombinant human granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor (rhu GM-CSF)

flag.reason: GM-CSF may be regarded as a vaccine adjuvant (part of the excluded vaccine regimen) rather than an investigational antitumour agent.

role_evidence.quote: Cyclophosphamide is an alkylating agent, used for immunopotentiation.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, used here at immunomodulatory dosing
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: used for immunopotentiation; antineoplastic and immunosuppressant agent to modulate immunity

flag.reason: Cyclophosphamide is given for immunopotentiation alongside a vaccine; could be read as supportive/vaccine adjunct rather than a candidate.

role_evidence.quote: A therapeutic antibody that binds to and blocks PD-1 located on lymphocytes. The receptor is generally responsible for preventing the immune system from attacking the body's own tissues - it is an immune checkpoint inhibitor.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds to and blocks PD-1 located on lymphocytes; immune checkpoint inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: This is a treatment clinical trial to assess the efficacy of ERC1671 in combination with bevacizumab and pembrolizumab in patients with GBM that has progressed following treatment with radiation and temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody (established recurrent GBM therapy)

coder_notes: Single-arm recurrent GBM trial of the ERC1671 tumour cell/lysate vaccine (excluded type) with GM-CSF, cyclophosphamide, bevacizumab and pembrolizumab. Pembrolizumab is a clear pharmacological candidate (experimental_combination), so S6 passes regardless. GM-CSF and cyclophosphamide coded experimental_combination but flagged uncertain: they may be vaccine adjuncts. Bevacizumab is described in the arm/summary but is not a registered intervention; it is an established GBM therapy given to every patient as background -> soc_backbone. 'WHO grade IV malignant gliomas (glioblastoma)' without IDH requirement -> historical terminology. Conditions say only 'Glioma, Malignant' but glioblastoma is named in title-free inclusion criteria and arm text, so gbm_only.
